summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Bobby Portis, an American professional basketball player. It states he plays for the New York Knicks in the NBA, played college basketball for the Arkansas Razorbacks, and was drafted 22nd overall by the Chicago Bulls in the 2015 NBA draft.
one_line: Bobby Portis is an American NBA basketball player for the New York Knicks, formerly of the Arkansas Razorbacks and the 2015 Chicago Bulls draftee.
key_facts: Bobby Portis was born on February 10, 1995.
Bobby Portis is an American professional basketball player.
Bobby Portis plays for the New York Knicks of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
Bobby Portis played college basketball for the Arkansas Razorbacks.
Bobby Portis was drafted with the 22nd overall pick.
The Chicago Bulls drafted Bobby Portis in the 2015 NBA draft.
Bobby Portis was selected 22nd overall in the 2015 NBA draft by the Chicago Bulls.
